stem:
Meena makes a simple circuit with a cell, wires and a small lamp. Two ends of wire are left free. She touches the two free ends with one object to see whether the lamp glows.
Which object will make the lamp glow?

options.text: a plastic ruler from her pencil box
a steel spoon from the kitchen
a piece of dry wooden stick

teacher.key_rationale: A lamp glows only when the circuit is completed by a conductor. Steel (a metal) conducts electricity, so touching the free ends with a steel spoon completes the circuit and the lamp glows. Plastic, rubber and dry wood are insulators and block the current.
